lessons.title: Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Green Living
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Green Living.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.term: Future: Will vs. Be going to
concepts.definition: 'Will' is used for spontaneous decisions made at the moment of speaking and personal predictions without evidence. 'Be going to' is used for pre-existing plans and predictions based on present evidence.
concepts.example: Look at those black clouds! It is going to rain. (Evidence). I am thirsty. - I will get you some water. (Spontaneous).
concepts.essence: Planning and evidence separate 'be going to' from spontaneous impulse 'will'.

rules.meaning: Subject + Be (conjugated) + Past Participle (V3/ed) + (by Agent). Used when the action or object is more important than the doer.
rules.example: Plastic bottles are collected and recycled into eco-friendly bags.
rules.essence: Shifts focus from the subject doing the action to the recipient or outcome of the action.

workedExamples.prompt: Rewrite in the passive voice: 'People should plant more trees in urban areas.'
steps: Step 2: Modal verb passive form: modal + be + V3 => 'should be planted'.
Step 3: Combine with remaining prepositional phrase: 'in urban areas'.
workedExamples.answer: More trees should be planted in urban areas.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'will' for a plan already arranged last week.
commonMistakes.why: Pre-meditated intentions and existing plans require 'be going to' or Present Continuous.
